notes.notes:
Hi All 

If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- is on sale this week for 20% off! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/4883acf9a5498a763665e649389ba1ef0944e215.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/923810/If_My_Heart_Had_Wings_Flight_Diary

Take to the skies again in If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-.
Technically a bonus story to the popular If My Heart Had Wings, Flight Diary acts as a sort of sequel to the main story. As well as including the prologue and epilogue to the main game, Flight Diary shares six new stories from the series. 


[quote]"All people meet in the sky!"
A group of boys and girls have their first real encounter with the sky - an encounter which provides the foundation for their new shared dream: to soar to the far side of the clouds, on wings into which they've poured their hopes and wishes.
The setting is Kazegaura - a lovely little town where the wind blows pleasantly. Today, a boy named Aoi Minase waits for the wind with his friends on a hill lined with windmills.
Once again, they await the time for departure - to take off on the sprawling, white wings of a glider.
The sky above stretches out to infinity. Their goal: the highest point in the sky possible. [/quote]

Grab If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- now while the sales last!

With her support, will the Soaring Club reach the skies once again?


[h1]Meet Akari![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/728091751ed2b2718faeecdbebd088cf8bce3fad.png[/img]

Akari Kumoi is the Student Council president in If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-, and is a very serious and hardworking girl.

While she’s very strict toward people who don’t follow rules and procedures, she can be understanding and lenient as long as there is a proper reason. However, she is quite warm-hearted and sympathetic, she isn’t simply all business.

She made many requests for improvements to the Soaring Club, but also stood up for the members against teachers’ unreasonable demands.

notes.title: If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- Out Now!
notes.notes:
Take to the skies now with the release of If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vA18Aoikmgk
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/8f3fee255036785bd0f8e3f459fcb616154ec471.jpg[/img]

[i]"All people meet in the sky!"[/i]

A group of boys and girls have their first real encounter with the sky - an encounter which provides the foundation for their new shared dream: to soar to the far side of the clouds, on wings into which they've poured their hopes and wishes.

The setting is Kazegaura - a lovely little town where the wind blows pleasantly. Today, a boy named Aoi Minase waits for the wind with his friends on a hill lined with windmills.

Once again, they await the time for departure - to take off on the sprawling, white wings of a glider.

The sky above stretches out to infinity. Their goal: the highest point in the sky possible. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/923810/If_My_Heart_Had_Wings_Flight_Diary


[h1]The Morning Glory Collection[/h1]
To celebrate the release of If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-, a special collection containing both If My Heart Had Wings and If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- has been released. 
This collection will allow new players to get both games together at 45% off, opening up a new world to the skies for newcomers to the If My Heart Had Wings games. 

[b]If My Heart Had Wings[/b]
If My Heart Had Wings is an animated visual novel presenting a lovely and bittersweet tale of youth. Take on the role of Aoi Minase in this romantic-comedy as he meets various young girls in his hometown and works together with them to revive their school’s glider-flying “Soaring Club” in order to realize their shared dream of flight.

[b]If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-[/b]
While If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- is technically a fan disc for If My Heart Had Wings, it includes six stories - including the prologue and epilogue to the main story - and acts as a sort of sequel to the original.

The Morning Glory Collection: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10306/

notes.title: LoveKami -Healing Harem- Out Now!
notes.notes:
We are really excited to announce that the third installment in the LoveKami series is out now on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/938270/LoveKami_Healing_Harem/
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/1ad82ed6ca43a2b500bedff80175a83dfdbdbcb8.jpg[/img]

LoveKami -Healing Harem- is a visual novel set in the same universe as LoveKami -Divinity Stage- and LoveKami -Useless Goddess-.
With a different setting to the previous two chapters, Healing Harem introduces us to the Tatarigami, cursed Goddesses, known for spreading misfortune. 
Set in a community deep within the mountains, Akira spends most of his time listening to the goddess' troubles and helped them find solutions. 


[h1]Story Introduction[/h1]
[i]"I'll find a solution to the goddess' problems!"[/i]

The more things seem the same, the more they're actually different... 
These are some strange little stories about Goddesses in love. 
They happened in a time when Goddesses and people lived in close proximity, six years after the Goddesses descended to Earth.

Our story takes place in Kamimori City, a community deep in the mountains that is known among some people for one thing; the area is protected by a Tatarigami.
Tatarigami are known for spreading misfortune, but Kamimori City is protected by one.

Akira Manase has inherited a shrine in Kamimori City, and spent his days listening to the Goddess' troubles. One day, he helped one of the Tatarigami, Yukari, and she fell madly in love with him, almost immediately proposing marriage.

[i]"Please make me your wife!"[/i]

However, there were Goddesses other than Yukari who were also in love with Akira, and they were intent on staking their claim. As the Goddesses vie for his hand in marriage, Akira spends his days helping them solve their problems.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/94156d83410088ecfffd6e19b297d45e11d8cba0.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
We are super excited to announce that LoveKami -Healing Harem- is coming to Steam this November 14th! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/31b8a8afaff2b9dcde2c80b61651f26d93867c08.jpg[/img]
https://youtu.be/kExtiNmmnik

[h1]This fall, get ready for a heavenly love like you’ve never experienced before![/h1]
LoveKami -Healing Harem-, the third installment in the LoveKami series, is coming to Steam this November. 
LoveKami -Healing Harem- is a visual novel set in the same universe as LoveKami -Divinity Stage- and LoveKami -Useless Goddess-.
With a different setting to the previous two chapters, Healing Harem introduces us to the Tatarigami, cursed Goddesses, known for spreading misfortune. 
Set in a community deep within the mountains, Akira spends most of his time listening to the goddess' troubles and helped them find solutions. 

Add LoveKami -Healing Harem- to your wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/938270/LoveKami_Healing_Harem 

[h1]Story[/h1]
[i]"I'll find a solution to the goddess' problems!"[/i]

The more things seem the same, the more they're actually different... 
These are some strange little stories about Goddesses in love. 
They happened in a time when Goddesses and people lived in close proximity, six years after the Goddesses descended to Earth.

Our story takes place in Kamimori City, a community deep in the mountains that is known among some people for one thing; the area is protected by a Tatarigami.
Tatarigami are known for spreading misfortune, but Kamimori City is protected by one.

Akira Manase has inherited a shrine in Kamimori City, and spent his days listening to the Goddess' troubles. One day, he helped one of the Tatarigami, Yukari, and she fell madly in love with him, almost immediately proposing marriage.

[i]"Please make me your wife!"[/i]

However, there were Goddesses other than Yukari who were also in love with Akira, and they were intent on staking their claim. As the Goddesses vie for his hand in marriage, Akira spends his days helping them solve their problems.

notes.title: Introducing Hiroki from Adventure of a Lifetime
notes.notes:
With Adventure of a Lifetime releasing on Steam on April 26th, we wanted to introduce the characters to you! 

Today we will be meeting the main character, Hiroki! 

[h1]Hiroki[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/f6fe504488ff58bb6a515ad213b4f419426be57c.png[/img]

Full Name: Hiroki Mizuno
Age: 16
Height: 177cm

[quote][i]"I'm a sucker for adventure. Runs in the family.”[/i][/quote]

Deciding to spend his summer vacation at his grandmother’s house, Hiroki comes to Ogasawara for the first time in years.
He used to come every year as a child, but since entering junior high, he’s been unable to make the trip due to his parents’ work and other circumstances.
So this year, he came to the island on his own.
Having come to the island partially for a bit of self-discovery, he encounters a girl in even more need of self-discovery than himself.

Hiroki has a bright and big-hearted personality, but has some strong feelings and ideas when it comes to food.
He even plans to acquire his cook’s license and become a chef after graduating high school.

Thanks to his participation in various school sports clubs, he’s very athletic and is an excellent swimmer.
In the past, he was once scuba diving buddies with Chisa.

notes.notes:
With Adventure of a Lifetime releasing on Steam on April 26th, we wanted to introduce the characters to you! 

Today we will be meeting Chisa! 

[h1]Chisa[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/f0bf623d3c76ee8259d43f150ecc2a2db8de81ee.png[/img]

Full Name: Chisa Ogasawara
Age: 16
Height: 155cm
B/W/H: 86/57/83
CV: Yuki Takada

[quote][i]“Once summer's over, I'll be left behind again.”[/i][/quote]

A deeply-tanned local girl.
The same age as her childhood friend, Hiroki, Chisa’s parents run the island diving shop.
To help her family out, she helps tourists to swim with dolphins and works a part-time job collecting mail from the underwater postbox.

She’s a bright, energetic, and healthy girl with a great figure.
She shows absolutely no signs of shyness and is able to get along with just about anyone, but at the same time she’s also able to maintain a comfortable distance.
While she tends to whine and complain, she’s also a warm-hearted person who simply can’t ignore someone in trouble.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/e2ddc7c303308e9687ff4b682de7178011a616bb.png[/img]

An extremely skilled swimmer, she can hold her breath underwater for an amazingly long time and feels most at home when in the water.
She often wears her swimsuit around town just to be able to get into the water anytime.
She can often be seen swimming together with Phin, the stray dolphin.

Something apparently happened with Hiroki way back when, and to this day she harbors feelings for him that she just can’t seem to put into words.

notes.title: Introducing Emily from Adventure of a Lifetime
notes.notes:
With Adventure of a Lifetime releasing on Steam on April 26th, we wanted to introduce the characters to you! 

Today we will be meeting Emily! 

[h1]Emily[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/c7e9e333bcd0a4c1d264b090d6aed000096aa05f.png[/img]

Full Name: Emily Shirase
Age: 16
Height: 162cm
B/W/H: 88/58/86
CV: Akari Kito

[quote][i]“There’s something I need to get back. Something precious that sank into the ocean years ago."[/i][/quote]

A young girl in a high school uniform, with blonde hair and blue eyes.
This half-Japanese, half-American girl Hiroki meets on the ferry heading to the island says she’s on her way to Ogasawara, which has a special place in her parents’ hearts.

Possibly due to the fact that she basically ran away from home to make the journey, at first she seems extremely suspicious of those around her, and she has quite the attitude.
Every once in awhile, she shows signs of something troubling her, deep down inside.
However, while her personality is actually somewhat shy, she also has a bit of naiveté about her and forges ahead full of baseless confidence.
Coming from a wealthy family and fortunate enough to be aesthetically stunning, she sometimes also shows flashes of a “less fortunate” side as well.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/553336183ad008a570fcbb2f183f2305c58886c6.png[/img]

Emily ends up working a part-time job at Hiroki’s grandmother’s cafe, Machiko’s Cafe.

She’s also a total beginner at diving.
Due to her fear of sharks, she’s also afraid of the sea in general, and is completely unable to swim.
But thanks to the support of her friends and a stray dolphin, she manages to overcome her fears.

notes.notes:
[h1]“There’s something I need to get back. Something precious that sank into the ocean years ago.”[/h1]

https://youtu.be/x57-baEycKc 

An all-new yet nostalgic tale of youth and the sea...
Set against a backdrop 1000km south of Tokyo in the Ogasawara Islands, a city boy, a half-Japanese, half-American runaway girl, and a girl from the neighborhood―all from vastly different worlds―come together in this nostalgic summer tale of teenage love, friendship, and growth.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/820730/capsule_616x353.jpg[/img]

Emily, the runaway, has her heart set on retrieving a treasure lost at sea. The city boy, Hiroki, and the local girl, Chisa, find Emily engaging in some pretty dangerous behavior and decide that they can’t just let her have all the fun. The three join forces and set off to find the treasure, said to be left behind in a shipwreck.

Youth―a time of crashing waves and ebbing and flowing tides, when the sun shines down on the glistening blue sea.

notes.title: If My Heart Had Wings Simplified Chinese Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hi All

[h1]We are really excited to announce that you can now play If My Heart Had Wings in Simplified Chinese![/h1]

We understand that many people may be a little worried about the quality of the Simplified Chinese translation. However, we can assure you that the text was translated from the original Japanese in order to preserve the essence. 
However, some of the Japanese jokes where a tad difficult to fully put across into Simplified Chinese and as per request of the original developers, has gained a literal translation in some areas. 
If you do not understand, please post in the forums, and we will be happy to offer a more detailed explanation! 

[u]Please note that the Simplified Chinese version cannot be purchased directly! You will need to buy the English version of If My Heart Had Wings and then get a free upgrade to the Simplfied Chinese version by downloading the DLC.[/u]

If you encounter any issues in upgrading to the Simplified Chinese version, please let us know in the forums, as we will be happy to help. We will be working to answer your questions as soon as possible. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208711/aafae4ac0094dfc867d134e9ecfc4bdb726c0777.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/734430/___If_My_Heart_Had_Wings__Simplified_Chinese/

[h1][b]Please note the following for installing the Simplified Chinese Edition of If My Heart Had Wings[/b][/h1]
[quote][h1]Precautions on using the Simplified Chinese Language Pack for If My Heart Had Wings[/h1]
This is the Simplified Chinese Language pack for If My Heart Had Wings, which must be applied to the original English version to convert it into the Simplified Chinese version of the game. Those who don't own the base English version will not be able to use this pack, so please buy the English version first.

[h1]Important Information[/h1]
Save files between the base English version and Simplified Chinese version of the games are not inter-compatible.
You will not be able to use save data from one version of the game with another. i.e. save data created on the base English version cannot be used on the Simplified Chinese version of the game or vice versa.

You can boot into the Simplified Chinese version of the game by selecting the Simplified Chinese Language Pack upon boot. When you boot the Simplified Chinese version of the game it will default to Simplified Chinese. You can change between Simplified Chinese and English from Config > System.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208711/dc42605c6416a7ebbdcfca786fc0202275bad3b9.png[/img]

Conversely, you can boot into the base English version of the game by selecting the English Language Pack upon boot. The base English version of the game will not have options to switch languages (as it never included them). 

[h1]I installed the pack, but now my game won't boot?[/h1]
The Simplified Chinese version of the game requires a new version of Visual C++ Redistributables to be installed to function correctly. 

These are installed alongside the Simplified Chinese Language pack so you may be able to resolve the issue by uninstalling the Simplified Chinese Language Pack and base game, and then reinstalling them.[/quote]


We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: A Sky Full of Stars Yow Interview
notes.notes:
Hi All!

We hope that you are enjoying A Sky Full of Stars! 
With the game being out for a month now, we are keen to share some behind the scenes information with you from the creators themselves. 

Today we will be posting the the final interview from Yow, the Director of A Sky Full of Stars.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/0bf7fc9348eab4ca7574dcb0768ea5739e1ef0e8.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Please tell us how this project began.[/h1]

After IMHHW, the question of what to do next had already been brought up. We had already received requests from fans of IMHHW for a sequel or a similar new project, as well. Konno and I talked over what kind of story we wanted to do, and the project came together over time. A similar thing happened with IMHHW. I came up with the astronomy aspect, and Konno was the one who came up with the idea of the characters being childhood friends. The story basically became a fusion of those two ideas.


[h1]★ Was there anything you changed overall after your experience making IMHHW?[/h1]

While retaining the good things [about IMHHW], we also made the decision to put more focus on the characters. Not just their devotion to their clubs, but we also put more focus on their interpersonal relationships. Besides the characterizations, we also changed a bit of our approach to their outward design too, such as making their hair more colorful.
In IMHHW, the viewpoint would change frequently by flying in the sky, and so on, but this time we decided to flip that and pay more attention to the “point of view”. We also changed the audio to binaural recordings and increased the size of the background images, experimenting with how we could make for a more immersive experience.


[h1]★ What theme did you have in mind for this project?[/h1]

 “Some things change, and others stay the same.” We wanted the story to revolve around changes in relationships, in your surroundings, in the stars above, and in how people change within (be it growing up, or giving up). That, plus the idea of finding an unchanging something to treasure in all that was the theme we had in mind.


[h1]★ What specific places did you model the setting after?[/h1]

We based the setting off of Hitachi City in Ibaraki Prefecture. However, not entirely, instead taking elements, for example the dam or the railway tracks, and putting them together.
We chose Hitachi City because the mountains and the city exist in close proximity, and it had just the right comfortable and flourishing atmosphere to it.


[h1]★ What gave you difficulties on the technical side of things?[/h1]

Just the sheer amount of material we had, and how much we had to create and make use of in the story proved a challenge. However, I intended to use it all as thoroughly as possible.
Other than that, anything related to the starry sky, I suppose. I would tell the creators and the developers what I wanted, but so much of it was based just on feelings that it took a while before we got it exactly what I was aiming for.


[h1]★ Can we ask for one more comment to finish?[/h1]

Thank you for purchasing “A Sky Full of Stars”!
I hope that you enjoyed our little youthful drama! We aimed for a story that put emphasis on the feeling of being together, and the importance of being there for someone, and hope that you can be taken back to get a taste of your own youth in the process.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1655504438992902731]Asta Konno (Part 1)[/url] / [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1655504438992903428]Asta Konno (Part 2)[/url] / [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1655504438992904114]Eiji Takashima[/url]

notes.title: A Sky Full of Stars Eiji Takashima Interview
notes.notes:
Hi All!

We hope that you are enjoying A Sky Full of Stars! 
With the game being out for a month now, we are keen to share some behind the scenes information with you from the creators themselves. 

Today we will be posting the Eiji Takashima's interview. He was in charge of Planning and the Main Scenario. He wrote Orihime and Korona's Routes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/c11841d0a4d339432b7c741485453448d90435b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Can you tell us your impressions, or what you first thought when you were approached about this project?[/h1]

I was first contacted directly about this project while I was still writing the scenario for “Natsu-iro Recipe”. We had a meeting where they gave me the details and I was asked if I wanted to be a part of it. Before that, they had already asked me to keep my schedule open for a new project [after Natsu-iro Recipe], so there was no problem in that area. That said, I didn’t know a single thing about astronomy, so I felt a lot of pressure, wondering if I was the right person for the job.


[h1]★ What scene are you proud to say you wrote well?[/h1]

The kotatsu scene! Is the answer I want to give, but thinking back on it I’m not so sure. A scene I found memorable I suppose was when Korona overcame her feud with Saya. My first draft very much played into my own tastes, so it was difficult for me when Yow asked for rewrites.


[h1]★ What scenes did you find difficult?[/h1]

All of the scenes that involved astronomy gave me difficulty. I really didn’t know anything about it. I did some research when outlining the plot, but when actually writing out the scenarios it involved a lot of fact-checking, which took a lot of time. For the scenes where the stars were out in the sky, I used a simulator program on the computer, which was a new experience for me. It was difficult, but I enjoyed it.


[h1]★ What characters do you like?[/h1]

My favorite heroine is Orihime. I’ll admit I’m attached to her, plus her looks and personality appeal to me. As for the other characters, I like Narue. Even in the scenes I wrote myself I found a lot of her lines memorable. The common route also gave me the impression that she has a lot of common sense, and she believes in her convictions. She sets out to do something, and does it. I think you could almost say she’s the most mature character in the story. That’s just my opinion, though.


[h1]★ To finish, can you tell us any memories you have of writing the story overall?[/h1]

The story takes place in, and the game itself was first released in winter, but I was writing it in the middle of summer, which made some aspects a little difficult for me. Keeping with the seasonal theme was important for this story, so I couldn’t just pay lip service to the idea of it taking place in winter; I had to make sure you could feel it throughout the story. Also, this is more before writing than during the process, but I also enjoyed going stargazing with Konno and everyone. We agreed that all the research about astronomy in the world wouldn’t mean much if we didn’t go out and see it for ourselves. It really made a difference, too, and having seen it with my own eyes helped very much with the writing process. It actually made me want to do more stargazing, but we just couldn’t find the time during the scenario writing stage. I still regret that we didn’t get to see the Perseid meteor shower…

notes.title: A Sky Full of Stars Asta Konno Interview (Part 2)
notes.notes:
Hi All!

We hope that you are enjoying A Sky Full of Stars! 
With the game being out for a month now, we are keen to share some behind the scenes information with you from the creators themselves. 

Today we will be posting the second half of Asta Konno's interview. ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1655504438992902731]Read Part 1 here[/url])
Asta Konno was in charge of Planning and the Main Scenario. He wrote Hikari, Saya and the Common Routes. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/0d0f6b702f7e7c08338b1c0e4a20c9827b046d85.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Did you already know a lot about astronomy beforehand?[/h1]

Before getting involved in this project, I barely knew what a planet was. Once we decided on the astrology aspect, I spent about a year carrying books on astrology everywhere with me and reading them whenever I had some extra time. Not just books, I also went out to do some field research and ask experts to show me around astrology-related shops. One of my hobbies is photography, so I started with telescopes, since that seemed somewhat related. 


[h1]★ What scenes do you think you wrote well, or would choose as your favorites?[/h1]

I think I wrote the scene where the three friends go to the hot springs pretty well. It’s a pretty delicate scene, and if I didn’t get it just right I knew the users would see that. Or the scene in Hikari’s route where Hikari and Saya are arguing on the phone but then they get excited together over the appearance of the bolide. It both involved astronomy information, but also was very like those two to act that way.
An instant favorite scene of mine was also the scene where the teacher speaks seriously near the end of the common route. The voice actor’s beautiful delivery of the line “Their light has made the journey. That’s why we can see them.” really gets to me every time I hear it.


[h1]★ Okay, then on the other hand, what were the scenes that were difficult to write?[/h1]

All of the astronomy-related scenes. I was a complete amateur who had only scratched the surface of all there was to learn, so it was difficult to make progress when every scene I had to look up and double check all of the information with at least two sources. My writing pace ended up being twice as slow as usual until I wondered if I was slowing down from all the work I was doing, but then my pace returned to normal on the other non-astronomy-related scenes and my heart rested easier.
Also, some of the scenes with Comment Girl I started to wonder if it wasn’t too weird but it seems like that all went over well with the players, so I’m glad I kept it in.


[h1]★ Aside from the main heroines, since you wrote for them, which characters do you like?[/h1]

If I had to choose someone other than Hikari and Saya, I guess it would be the teacher, Miharu. I’m quite proud of how I wrote her as the kind of careless older-sister character you see often these days, but also drew the line at making her a complete failure at being an adult. (laughs) I think it’s pretty great she just spends her time lazing about at home grinding for levels in RPGs. I like Korona when she was a child. She looked and sounded adorable…
I also like Noriko. I love her type of “boring” girls.
And Hinami, too! She was the type of character who didn’t require any effort to make interesting, the kind you could just say “if this character appears at this point, they need to have a strong personality” and they just kind of write themselves. She looks and sounds cute too. She’s the best.


[h1]★ Overall, can you tell us what left an impression on you when writing this?[/h1]

Since working on this project, I’ve started looking up to the stars. I’d never seen a falling star in all my life, but while I was writing, I was able to see at least three falling stars that I swear were bolide-class during the Geminid meteor shower, and that left a great impression on me.
The lyrics to “Star map” and “Winter Diamond” are just wonderful, I think, so much that they almost made me frustrated thinking I’d never be able to write something so lovely.

notes.title: A Sky Full of Stars Asta Konno Interview (Part 1)
notes.notes:
Hi All!

We hope that you are enjoying A Sky Full of Stars! 
With the game being out for a month now, we are keen to share some behind the scenes information with you from the creators themselves. 

Today we will be posting the first half of Asta Konno's interview who was in charge of Planning and the Main Scenario. He wrote Hikari, Saya and the Common Routes. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/b2189ba50a7eba50122bfa2327894ccdaa5be316.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ How did you start planning this project?[/h1]

The director, Yow, was the first to bring up the idea of doing a story centered around stargazing, and in the beginning I said we shouldn’t because it seemed a bit lame. However, it was a topic I was interested in incorporating into a story, and since Yow wanted to do it, I gave it a shot and that became the story we have today.


[h1]★ Is there anything you changed from “If My Heart Had Wings” (herein IMHHW)?[/h1]

When we started planning we decided to put more emphasis on the characters. IMHHW was a story that was built in a straight line. We thought that an overly complicated melodramatic approach to character relationships didn’t suit it, and focused on making a more straightforward story. For “A Sky Full of Stars” (herein ASFS), we went out of our way to make it as difficult as possible. We thought it would be interesting to put together a scenario that made the characters have to really work to find the answers they sought.
What we wanted to retain was the atmosphere suiting the young characters, as well as the romance and excitement focused on the sky like we had in IMHHW. We wanted their values to be displayed not just by losses and gains.


[h1]★ What did you try to keep in mind when writing the scenario?[/h1]

I enjoyed the parts that came from Hikari, Saya, and Akito being childhood friends. The part where Comet Girl gets asked at what age it becomes weird to be a virgin, or Saya’s role as a commuter wife, there were a lot of moments that only worked because they were childhood friends. The scene where they went to the hot springs together, I kept laughing to myself as I wrote it because they were so silly. In IMHHW, we had Ageha in the role of the childhood friend, but that wasn’t part of the same story. The little things that were part of the setting but didn’t feel like they were used to their full potential in that story contributed a lot to ASFS I feel.


[h1]★ What were you careful about when writing the common route?[/h1]

How much time to spend on flashbacks. There was some negative feedback from users about it when we released the trial version. Putting too much emphasis on the flashbacks takes away from what’s happening in the present. However, part of the story dealt with how the past affected the present, so I made sure to put a lot of effort into showing that.
Also, with the way the story turned out, Hikari doesn’t appear for a while, which meant that in the beginning Saya had to carry much of the story by herself. I didn’t think that would lead to us putting so much emphasis on her commuter wife status, though. (laughs)

notes.title: Introducing Akito Sorami
notes.notes:
A Sky Full of Stars has a varied cast, with a lot of interactions and background stories tied together under the stars. Today we will be introducing the main character within the game; Akito Sorami. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/644c7614b570627aa317870b0ebe866747ef4f58.jpg[/img]

Make sure you didn't miss the other introductions:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1453964470342318079]Meet Hikari Houkiboshi[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1464097650383017995]Meet Saya Amanogawa[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1464097650383019543]Meet Orihime Shiratori[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1464097650383021874]Meet Korona Kusakabe[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1464097650383124835]Meet Miharu Saotome[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1464097650383126772]Meet Honoka Yoshioka[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/3114667637349330046]Meet Hinami Yamada[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/a59651616ae62e25897ac1c2d190d118c6780d62.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Akito Sorami[/h1]
	
[list][quote][i]"The Astronomer Who Never Looks at the Stars."[/i][/quote][/list]

Height: 176cm
	
A member of the astronomy club, but unwilling to look at the sky. For that reason he's called the astronomer who never looks at the stars.	
The only reason why he joined the club was so he could use the club room as a place to sleep. He's currently the only member.	
	
When he was a child, he first became interested in the stars when he and Hikari looked at the moon through the telescope his father had bought him.	
Not long after, Saya joined them to form a trio travelling the world of the stars.	
However, that all came to an end when Hikari's family moved away.	
After Hikari was gone, he and Saya also grew distant, and Akito decided he would no longer look at the stars.	
	
Some years later, Akito met Saya again at school, and they became like old friends again.	
While working part-time at the convenience store owned by his former teacher's family, he spends his days mountain climbing.	
There's nothing he loves more than a cup of instant coffee while watching the sun rise from atop a mountain.	

[list][quote][i]"I felt like I could reach the stars."[/i][/quote][/list]

The starry sky spreads far and wide overhead... This story full of love, comedy, and excitement follows our protagonist and his stargazing friends as they grow together. A Sky Full of Stars is a coming-of-age astronomy tale by the same team who brought you If My Heart Had Wings.

A Sky Full of Stars has a varied cast, with a lot of interactions and background stories tied together under the stars. Today we will be meeting the last of the four main heroines in the story; Korona Kusakabe. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/85aaf430583bb1cd115c11af7428c6ec8751ab32.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Korona Kusakabe[/h1]
va: Yuka Kotorii	
	
[list][quote][i]"Little Devil with a Crush!"[/i][/quote][/list]
	
Height: 153cm
B/W/H: 78/56/83
Birthday: September 3
Sign: Virgo
Blood type: AB
	
One year younger than Akito and the others, nothing quite seems to go her way.	
She thought Hikari was nice and had a crush on Akito.	
She wanted to be a part of their group, but she was too young.	
Then she watched as Saya immediately became close to them and that didn't sit right.	
That, on top of everything else, made her hate the fact that she was a year younger all the more.	
	
She loved Akito and tried desperately to get his attention, but as she was still a child with no sense of how to act properly, it made her act a little devilish.	
Her personality is a bit cat-like and contrary, but once she decides she likes you, she showers you with affection.	
	
That said, things rarely go her way.	
For example, should she spot Akito and run over to greet him, calling, "Heyyy, Akkyyy!", that's exactly the moment she'll fall out of sight in a ditch and end up crying when he doesn't find her.	
(true story)	
	
[list][quote][i]"Yep. So don't get any ideas about making moves on him, got it?"[/i][/quote][/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745960/A_Sky_Full_of_Stars/

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/0ba05f1f6fcd902358b994e447198c56cb999882.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Orihime Shiratori[/h1]
va: Soyogi Tono	

[list][quote][i]"Queen of the Constellations!"[/i][/quote][/list]
	
Height: 162cm
B/W/H: 93/57/89
Birthday: March 14
Sign: Pisces
Blood type: O
	
A senior at a private escalator school.	
Tall and curvy, at a glance she's a picture of beauty.	
Compared to clubs at other schools, the astronomy club at Orihime's school is active and has lots of supplies.	
	
She always speaks politely, and treats everyone graciously. At the same time, she can be a little flighty and mischievous.	
She also likes to act mysteriously, showing interest in shady fortunes.	
Orihime can also be elegant, as she comes from a rich family.	
	
This makes her seem a bit foreboding to some people, but she's actually very kind to her juniors.	
For this reason, people who don't know her will keep their distance, but her juniors all adore her.	
She's popular with both boys and younger girls.	
	
Orihime is also fairly strong-willed, and no matter how nice she may seem, once she makes up her mind there's no changing it.	
This is all an act to hide her insecurities, though.

Make sure you didn't miss Hikari's introduction:

A Sky Full of Stars has a varied cast, with a lot of interactions and background stories tied together under the stars. Today we will be meeting one of the other main characters in the story; Saya Amanogawa. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/38feb420d568c85959625a68ee9de7fcbdcd7150.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Saya Amanogawa[/h1]	
va: Meguri Yukina	
	
[list][quote][i]"Commuter wife with different colored eyes."[/i][/quote][/list]
	
Height: 154cm
B/W/H: 80/57/83
Birthday: January 16
Sign: Capricorn
Blood type: A

A pretty girl with two different colored eyes, one a brilliant blue, and the other a yellow-orange.
After seeing how she dutifully brings things for Akito when he starts sleeping in the astronomy club room, the other students begin calling her his "commuter wife".

She transferred to Akito's school when they were kids, and everyone was talking about the pretty girl who moved from the city.
At the time, she had a complex about her eyes, and always tried to hide them with sunglasses.
But then, she became friends with Akito and Hikari, and began stargazing with them.

Studious and serious, she gives off an aura of seeming mature for her age, but that's actually an act; she's actually a bit clumsy and people often feel the urge to take care of her.
She's shy and quiet around new people. It's only when she's near Akito that she can forget everyone around her and be herself.

Akito's childhood friend who suddenly appeared back in his life like a comet sweeping back on its orbit.

She's cheerful and positive, always willing to try something new.	
Sometimes her insatiable curiosity can cause trouble for those around her. 	

Stargazing for Hikari is just like travelling the galaxy together.	
Her interest in the stars, in seeing further, farther into the unknown propels her forward at the speed of light.	
She began to stargaze after meeting Akito and Saya, but their meetings were cut short when her family moved away and she lost touch with her friends until they met again several years later.

[h1]★ Hikari Houkiboshi[/h1]
va: Mocachoco	
[list][quote][i]"Here she comes, Comet Girl! Her pony tails trailing behind her like ionized gas and dust!"[/i][/quote][/list]
Height: 161cm
B/W/H: 91/58/88
Birthday: August 20
Sign: Leo
Blood type: O

Akito's childhood friend who suddenly appeared back in his life like a comet sweeping back on its orbit.	
Hikari, Akito, and Saya always used to stargaze together at the secret observatory.	
She's cheerful and positive, always willing to try something new.	
Sometimes her insatiable curiosity can cause trouble for those around her. 	

Stargazing for Hikari is just like travelling the galaxy together.	
Her interest in the stars, in seeing further, farther into the unknown propels her forward at the speed of light.	
She began to stargaze after meeting Akito and Saya, but their meetings were cut short when her family moved away and she lost touch with her friends until they met again several years later.	
By then, tomboyish country girl Hikari had grown into a cute and stylish teenager.

notes.title: A Sky Full of Stars coming this December
notes.notes:
[h1]We are excited to announce A Sky Full of Stars is coming this December![/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QNZZcr7VXSw

The starry sky spreads far and wide overhead... This story full of love, comedy, and excitement follows our protagonist and his stargazing friends as they grow together. A Sky Full of Stars is a coming-of-age astronomy tale by the same team who brought you If My Heart Had Wings. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/581e8717023dc2865aebbef1494fea9a0cc7f591.jpg[/img]

[h1]Story[/h1]
[quote][i]"This train is the Milky Way Railroad Observatory, headed for the sky!"[/i]

Back then, I felt we could go anywhere.
We could solve the mysteries of outer space. 
I felt like we could reach out our hands and catch the stars.

What we saw beyond the stars through our telescope was the past; days filled with excitement and anticipation we could never return to.
But the heavens continue to turn above our heads, and the feelings we thought we'd left behind come back to us as if they were a comet returning on its orbit to deliver a premonition.

[i]"Now then, let's depart for our next destination as we solve the mysteries of the universe!"[/i]

As friends, we looked to the sky, and the vibrant days spent revolving around the stars began anew... [/quote]


Make sure you add it to your wishlist now to stay up to date as we lead you to the stars this December!
